name: av_aroon
description:
Aroon indicator for one stock from Alpha Vantage (AROON).
Returns: {"Meta Data", "Technical Analysis: AROON"} keyed by date or timestamp, each with Aroon Up, Aroon Down. Alpha Vantage's JSON comes back unchanged, including its "Error Message" or "Information" notes; a network failure gives {"error": ...}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker); interval (1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min, daily, weekly or monthly; default daily); time_period (bars in the window; default 14 when omitted).
Use it for whether a trend is starting or fading; av_adx for trend strength. Raw prices: av_stock_daily.
Key: ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY (alpha_vantage.api.key); when unset the 'demo' key is sent, which only serves Alpha Vantage's documentation examples. Free tier: 25 requests/day.
Example: {"symbol": "IBM", "interval": "daily", "time_period": 14}

interval.description: Bar interval: 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min, daily, weekly or monthly

time_period.description: Number of bars in the indicator window
